rules: :root { color-scheme: light; --background: oklch(.985 .004 270); --surface: #fff; --foreground: oklch(.19 .012 270); --muted: oklch(.52 .012 270); --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 10%, var(--background)); --accent: #6e56cf; --accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); --success: #27956a; --success-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 11%, transparent); --danger: #c84b5d; --danger-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 11%, transparent); --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(25 23 32 / 8%), 0 8px 22px rgb(25 23 32 / 4%); }

:root[data-theme="dark"] { color-scheme: dark; --background: oklch(.16 .014 270); --surface: oklch(.205 .014 270); --foreground: oklch(.94 .008 270); --muted: oklch(.68 .01 270); --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 12%, var(--background)); --accent: #a98be1; --accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, transparent); --success: #62c99a; --success-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 14%, transparent); --danger: #ef8090; --danger-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 14%, transparent); --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%), 0 12px 26px rgb(0 0 0 / 16%); }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0px; }
body { overflow: hidden; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
button, input { color: inherit; font: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
.shell { display: grid; width: 100%; height: 100%; grid-template-rows: 64px minmax(0px, 1fr); background: var(--background); }

.topbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0px, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 0px 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, transparent); }
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
.brand-mark { display: grid; width: 26px; height: 26px; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); font-size: 12px; }
.tabs { display: flex; min-width: 0px; gap: 7px; }
.tab { min-height: 34px; padding: 0px 13px; border: 0px; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.tab.active { background: var(--surface); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }

.space { display: inline-flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.space-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); }
.main { width: 100%; max-width: 1260px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 46px 44px 72px; overflow-y: auto; }
.hero { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; }
.eyebrow { margin: 0px 0px 7px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
h1 { margin: 0px; font-size: 36px; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.05em; }
.lead { max-width: 690px; margin: 13px 0px 0px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; }
.quiet-link { min-height: 32px; padding: 0px 10px; border: 0px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.quiet-link:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); }
.section { margin-top: 34px; }
.section-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.section-head h2 { margin: 0px; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
.section-head p { margin: 6px 0px 0px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; }
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.card { display: flex; min-height: 222px; flex-direction: column; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 17px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.art { display: grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 26px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--success-soft); color: var(--success); font-size: 17px; }
.assistant .art { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.card h3 { margin: 0px; font-size: 16px; }
.source { margin: 4px 0px 0px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.description { margin: 17px 0px 0px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; }
.actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 7px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 14px; }

.button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 32px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 550; }
.button.primary { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: white; font-weight: 680; }
.button.ghost { border-color: transparent; color: var(--muted); }
.button.ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); }
.badge { display: inline-flex; min-height: 20px; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); font-size: 10px; }
.badge::before { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentcolor; content: ""; }
.badge.bad { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }
.subhead { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.subhead h1 { font-size: 28px; }
.search { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.search label { display: grid; width: min(480px, 100%); gap: 7px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }

.search input { height: 42px; padding: 0px 13px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 38%, var(--border)); border-radius: 10px; outline: 3px solid var(--accent-soft); background: var(--surface); }
.search > span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.catalog-card { min-height: 250px; }
.catalog-card.highlighted { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 56%, var(--border)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft), var(--shadow); }
.source-pill { display: inline-flex; align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 8px; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); font-size: 10px; }

.workspace { display: grid; min-height: 520px; place-items: center; align-content: center; padding: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); text-align: center; }
.workspace .art { width: 58px; height: 58px; margin: 0px 0px 18px; border-radius: 18px; font-size: 23px; }
.workspace h2 { margin: 0px; font-size: 22px; }
.workspace p { max-width: 620px; margin: 9px 0px 0px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; }
.workspace .actions { margin-top: 22px; }
.progress { width: min(420px, 100%); height: 7px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--border); }
.progress span { display: block; width: 38%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--accent); }

.assistant-boundary { display: grid; min-height: 600px; grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0px, 1fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.assistant-sidebar { padding: 18px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); }
.assistant-sidebar strong { font-size: 14px; }
.assistant-sidebar p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.assistant-body { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 36px; text-align: center; }
.assistant-body h2 { margin: 0px; font-size: 24px; }
.assistant-body p { max-width: 540px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

.boundary-note { margin-top: 18px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, var(--border)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.guard { display: none; position: fixed; z-index: 20; inset: 0px; place-items: center; padding: 24px; background: var(--background); text-align: center; }
.guard div { max-width: 320px; }
.guard h1 { font-size: 24px; }
.guard p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; }
